paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -3.59% on average, with Dow Jones strongest (-1.46%) and Hang Seng weakest (-5.77%). Brent crude changed -4.89% to 88.59. Gold changed -8.28% to 3,544.2. Bitcoin changed -3.83% to 59,533.2188. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.904%, a relative move of -3.90%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-13.69%) and Newmont (-10.40%) moved the most.
